blurb: Guests fish for striped bass and bluefish using live bait, dead bait, and artificial lures. Trips include catching live mackerel and menhaden to live line for big striped bass up to 50 pounds. The boat is trailerable and can launch from various harbors to follow the best fishing conditions.

extraNote: Deposit of $200 required to book all trips · Trips cancelled 10 or more days before trip receive full refund · Trips cancelled less than 10 days before trip forfeit full deposit · No shows must pay full cost of trip · Trips not cancelled for rain showers; captain decides on safety · If trip cancelled due to weather, 100% refund provided · Remaining balance due on day of trip · 20% gratuity is standard · Primarily Cohasset Harbor; can launch from any boat ramp from Boston to Cape Cod depending on best fishing conditions. · Early May through October
